items.title: Manhunt for escaped Tennessee murder convict crosses state lines after the truck he stole is found abandoned in Illinois
items.brief: The search for a convicted murderer who escaped from a Tennessee prison has crossed state lines after authorities found his stolen getaway truck in southern Illinois.

items.title: CNN, MS NOW and Politico expand lawsuit against Trump White House, citing continued ‘viewpoint discrimination’
items.brief: CNN, MS NOW and Politico have amended their lawsuit against President Donald Trump’s White House press ban, citing “continued retaliatory and viewpoint-discriminatory deprivation” by the Trump administration.

items.title: Hayden Panettiere death investigation closed by police in South Carolina
items.brief: Police in South Carolina closed the investigation into actress Hayden Panettiere’s death after it was determined she died of an accidental drug overdose, the Greenville police department said Wednesday.

items.title: Netanyahu is the ultimate survivor. But can he survive this time?
items.brief: In a political career that has spanned more than three decades, Benjamin Netanyahu has been written off too many times to count, only to prove the obituaries were penned prematurely.

items.title: Dolores Huerta, pioneering labor leader and civil rights icon, dies at 96
items.brief: Dolores Huerta, a pioneering labor organizer and civil rights icon who cofounded the United Farm Workers with Cesar Chavez in the 1960s, died at 96, her family said in a statement Wednesday.
